steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I didn't know there were so many people hiding around us. Could it be that all the gangsters have been lured here?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: We've already made such a scene. Where are the guys from the Legion? I thought they said they'd protect us?
Bang bang —you're not sure if you feel your suddenly quickened heartbeat first or hear the loud noise first.
A massive truck suddenly crashes down from above, tumbling between you and the thugs. After some howls and cries, the other side quickly falls silent in fear.
Several familiar figures appear atop the truck. Even against the moonlight, you can still clearly see Zoya's cold eyes.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Hmm, no wonder I barely found anyone, you've all come here for him, huh. I thought you wanted a fight with the Legion?
steps.female_content: Hmm, no wonder I barely found anyone, you've all come here for her, huh. I thought you wanted a fight with the Legion?

steps.speaker: Earl
steps.content: You put out a good bait. Now everyone's here.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ****, he's fishing too?

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: No way... Where's the Red Falcon? They have... They've sent so many people and taken the most weapons. They couldn't have lost, they couldn't have...

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: They were indeed numerous, I can't bring them all  back. I've only kept a few on me, take them as souvenirs.
She throws down a full handful of bloodied dog tags, smashing them onto the gangsters' faces. They yelp and fall onto the ground, backing up.

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: No! Don't come over!

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...Treacherous cowards. Even the authorities' lapdog has a thicker spine than you.
She curses and leaps down straight from the container, landing hard on the ground. She grabs the collar of one of the guys.
Debris keeps falling on his face, making him howl loudly in response.

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: Ahhhhhhhh! Mercy, mercy! I yield! I yield.

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: It's all the boss's order. I-I'm only a salaried employee, I was forced into it!

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: I have to survive, and the only way to do it is to join a gang. You know what it's like. That's how things work in Syndicate! I had no other options!

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: Spare me—I was forced into it, forced by life. It's all Syndicate's fault!
His howls are extremely sad, but Zoya's face is only growing colder. She draws out his long sword silently. Fine blood-red crystals are embedded on one side of the sword.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You've got a good sword.

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: ...Huh?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: A Mania weapon. The fancy type used for commendation within Yagyu. You've been taking good care of the sword. You love it and are proud of it.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: How many people did you kill with it to win this honor?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Among them, how many were kids, civilians, and innocent people? Did they die? Or did they get infected with the Mania?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: When you wield the sword, are you happy? Are you proud? Are you counting your kills and waiting for the next prize?

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: How many more good swords like this have you got?
She breaks the Mania long sword with her bare hand, then grips the Yagyu executive's neck.

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: Ah, ah... It's Syndicate... Syndicate turned me into... an evil person... It's not just me, it does that to everyone...

steps.speaker: Yagyu Executive
steps.content: Spare me, you've already won. No one else can beat you. According to the rules, you're the overlord of Syndicate, you're the boss! I'll do whatever you say, just don't kill me!

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: ...Yes. It's all Syndicate's fault. I'll destroy every part of it, including you.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: You've long become part of it.
Her hand tightens. The Yagyu executive grunts once, then goes quiet completely.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Overlord? Haha, it's because of the desire for such a thing, this place has become what it is.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I don't want to be your king. I want your death.
Dead silence. After a long while, she turns toward the Legion. Her voice has calmed down.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: I did it too quickly. Go and grill some of the other ones. Ask them where the inheritance is, who sent them, and who gave them the weapons.

steps.speaker: Zoya
steps.content: Once you're done, finish them off.
She stalks past you with her eyes staring straight ahead, but you still see the flames in her eyes vividly.
It's those icy flames again. You've finally confirmed that there's no future in her eyes, only an obsession with bringing destruction and death to the past.
You're no exception. You're the authorities' lapdog, her enemy.
You must get away from her.
